gateway.title: HA companion via RAK gateway
gateway.description: Own companion identity and contacts are stored in HA. Use the service key for the enabled gateway port, not the admin key. Trusted LAN only; the link is not encrypted.

error.not_gateway: This endpoint is not a supported raw gateway.
error.gateway_unavailable: Gateway unavailable. Enable the service port and release any other client using it.
error.invalid_gateway: Invalid gateway settings or missing HA identity storage. Restore the HA backup if the identity was lost.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check transport, device PIN and whether another app is using this interface.

abort.not_gateway: This entry is not a gateway companion.

allowed.title: Allowed contacts
allowed.description: Only selected contacts may trigger word events. An empty selection blocks all senders. Received messages remain visible in Activities.

favorites.title: Device favorites
favorites.description: Favorites are read from and written to the companion. Favoriting a contact does not authorize word events.

contact_learning.title: Automatic learning
contact_learning.description: Only new contacts are added. Existing favorites are never overwritten or evicted. Warning: automatically allowed contacts can trigger HA actions. This permission is off by default.

data.learn_allowed: Automatically allow HA actions for new contacts

contact_remove.title: Remove contact
contact_remove.description: This removes the contact from the connected companion and the word allowlist.

channel_add.title: Add channel
channel_add.description: Choose an empty slot. For a #hashtag channel leave the key empty. Private channels require the shared 32-character hexadecimal key.

channel_remove.title: Remove channel
channel_remove.description: This clears the selected channel on the connected companion.

word_add.title: Add word
word_add.description: Each word creates an event entity. Only exact messages from allowed contacts trigger it.

error.cannot_connect: Companion unavailable. Check the connection and whether another app is using it.
error.device_error: The device could not apply the change. Check the connection, values and available storage; reopen this menu to refresh its contents.
error.invalid_word: Enter a nonempty word or phrase (maximum 130 UTF-8 bytes), without line breaks.

abort.device_error: The device could not apply the change. Check the connection, values and available storage; reopen this menu to refresh its contents.

learn_allowed.name: Automatically allow HA actions for new contacts

execute_action.name: Execute action and reply
execute_action.description: Run local actions for an authorized word request and reply to the original sender.

get_contacts.name: Read contacts
get_contacts.description: Read contacts or favorites directly from the connected companion.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Queue a private message to a device contact. Queued does not mean delivered.
